current_task_binding.dataset_name: NASA-USDA Enhanced SMAP Global Soil Moisture Data

spatial_coverage.coverage: Hillslopes susceptible to rainfall-triggered shallow soil slides, where SMAP-enhanced Palmer-model soil moisture is available between 60°S and 90°N.

analytical_capabilities: Track surface and subsurface soil moisture variability across global land areas
Analyze precomputed surface and subsurface soil-moisture anomalies against the SMAP-record climatology
Map wet and dry spatial patterns and their evolution through time
Summarize long-term trends, persistence, and extreme moisture conditions
Combine with other gridded climate or hazard datasets for spatiotemporal comparison

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Surface and subsurface soil moisture in millimeters (mm); soil-moisture profile as a fraction; anomalies dimensionless
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use `ssm` for surface soil moisture and `susm` for subsurface soil moisture, both in mm; `smp` is the soil-moisture profile fraction; `ssma` and `susma` are dimensionless anomalies relative to the SMAP-record climatology. Images follow a 3-day cadence rather than daily, so align temporal aggregation to that interval.

directions.research_question: 研究问题是能否结合 SMAP 积水、NASA-USDA SMAP 土壤水分、降水预报和 Landsat 水体观测预测区域及流域尺度的洪水淹没范围。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 洪水淹没受降水、初始土壤湿润程度和既有地表积水共同影响，初始土壤湿润程度会调节降雨向积水和饱和超渗径流的转化。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 使用 NASA-USDA SMAP global surface soil moisture 表示预测日前的背景土壤湿润程度，使用 SMAP FW 表示前期地表积水条件，使用 GFS 累计地表降水预报作为降雨预测变量，以 Landsat water mask 聚合的积水比例作为训练和验证目标，并用 ARIA 洪水产品独立评估预测结果。
used_assets: NASA-United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) SMAP global soil moisture dataset
United States Geological Survey (USGS) Landsat water mask data
National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) Global Forecast System (GFS) 384-Hour Predicted Atmosphere Data
NASA Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA) flood inundation products
directions.evidence_granularity: GPT/opus admitted open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 研究不同水文变量如何共同反映尼罗河流域水资源、水分补给和水分胁迫的时空变化，并评估城市化变化。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 降水、蒸散发和径流等水文过程与土壤水分变化共同影响地下水补给和陆地水储量，并可用于解释水分胁迫变化。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 使用NASA-United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Global Soil Moisture Dataset的地表和地下土壤水分、土壤水分剖面及异常，使用CHIRPS降水、FLDAS蒸散发和径流、GRACE陆地水储量异常进行月尺度趋势、相关和水量平衡分析；使用Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance和NLCD开展城市不透水面变化检测与建模。
directions.method_paradigm: 趋势分析与关系机制分析
used_assets: NASA-United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Global Soil Moisture Dataset

directions.research_question: How can remotely sensed and model-based hydrological datasets, including SMAP soil-moisture products, be operationally processed to produce spatial representations of hydrological parameters for the Hazar Lake and Behramaz Basins?
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: Surface soil moisture provides an operational indicator of water stored near the soil surface and can support characterization of hydrological processes such as infiltration, evapotranspiration, runoff, and groundwater recharge.
directions.variables_and_data_use: For January 2023, SMAP L3 morning-overpass soil_moisture_am and SMAP L4 Version 8 sm_surface at 0-5 cm were filtered by date and temporally averaged in Google Earth Engine to generate pixel-based mean surface-soil-moisture maps.
directions.method_paradigm: Remote-sensing and geospatial data processing using Google Earth Engine, including temporal filtering, band selection, and pixel-wise temporal averaging for map generation.
